title: Instagram UGC Ad Videos for Reels | AIVideosUGC
description: Build Instagram UGC ad videos from one product photo. Add a voice and captions, then post the Reel to Stories, Reels, or the main feed today.
h1: Instagram UGC Ad Videos From One Photo
lead: Instagram UGC ad videos can keep running on weeks when no creator is free. The Reel comes from the product page, and you can make a second version in another setting before the offer ends.
card: Instagram ads from one product photo, as a tall clip or a square photo.

faq.q: What counts as an Instagram ad I can run?
faq.a: It is a paid Reel, Story, or feed post: someone holding your product, an unboxing, or a short review. It sits more comfortably beside friends' posts than a glossy brand film does.

faq.q: How do I get an Instagram Reel from my product link?
faq.a: Paste the product page and say who the buyer is. You get a Reel with captions, and you pick the avatar before you export.

faq.q: Are there ready Reel templates I can post?
faq.a: Yes. Open a Reel template and keep your product in the frame. The tall shape is already set, so you do not measure the edges yourself.

faq.q: What does an Instagram Reel cost in credits?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the cost first. A failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Do I get music, captions, and a voice on the Reel?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, captions, and a track from the music library. The same script can be spoken in another language. You can still change a word before you export.

faq.q: Can I run the Reel as a paid Instagram ad?
faq.a: Yes. Publish it or download it and run it in Instagram ads. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Instagram still applies its own ad rules to every file.

faq.q: Do I have to book a person and a room for the Reel?
faq.a: No. Use a photo you already have. The person in the Reel is an AI avatar from a library of 53 AI actors. The setting can be the one already in the photo.

faq.q: What should I check on the Reel before I download it?
faq.a: Compare your placement with [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), then preview the file so on-screen buttons do not cover the product.

platforms.h2: Post the Same Photo on Other Channels
platforms.lead: The same product photo can start a file for TikTok, Facebook, Shorts, Amazon, or Shopify. Instagram is one of those placements.

reviews.h2: How Shops Put an Instagram Ad Together
reviews.lead: Four ways a shop uses one product photo.

items.d: They paste the hand-cream page and post a Reel of the jar being applied by the bathroom mirror. The creator day stays off the calendar.
They upload the mug photo and get a Reel of it on a linen desk. The same photo covers the feed test, so they skip a second shoot.
They start with the three balm tubes, then show a hand using one of them. Both clips come from the photos they already had.
They keep the hand-cream jar and change only the spoken line for the next Reel. The look stays one product, and they do not book anyone new.
